title: Uji Beban Kereta Sorong Five Star di Jalan Bergelombang
hook: Gerobak murah baru muat batu sedikit rodanya langsung goyang
story: Pekerja bangunan mendorong Kereta Sorong Five Star yang baknya penuh batu belah melewati jalur kerikil dan paving rusak di halaman material. Sejak detik 0.0s bak merah, ban angin, dan tumpukan batu sudah terlihat. Ia berjalan menuju kamera, berhenti, menekan bibir bak dua kali untuk menunjukkan platnya tidak melengkung, lalu menatap lensa dan mengajak menyimpan video sebagai acuan beli.
caption:
Gerobak murah sering goyang asnya begitu bak penuh batu. Kereta Sorong Five Star pakai bak plat baja tebal jadi rangkanya tetap kaku lewat jalan bergelombang, tanya spek lengkapnya tinggal kirim pesan ke DM.
#keretasorongfivestar #alatproyek #materialbangunan #intansuarkartika

shots.prompt: Photorealistic live-action video, vertical 9:16, 12 seconds, one continuous take, shot on a smartphone vlog camera at 24fps held low near the ground at wheel height and angled slightly upward, with a gentle natural handheld sway, the camera moving backward ahead of the cart so the pneumatic tyre, the red tray and the worker stay in frame. Location: a building-material yard in Medan with a bumpy track of loose gravel and broken paving running toward the camera, a stack of red bricks at the left edge and blurred sand piles behind, bright overcast morning light. The wheelbarrow is exactly the product in the single attached official reference photo: bright glossy red pressed-steel tray, red tubular frame with a curved front bumper, white FIVE STAR sticker on the left handle, black rubber grips and a thick treaded pneumatic tyre. An Indonesian male construction worker about 35 years old in a dusty navy long-sleeve work shirt, dark work trousers, grey cotton work gloves and brown work shoes pushes it toward the lens at walking pace; his torso, gloved hands, legs and face are in frame. PROP CONTINUITY RULE: from 0.0s to 12.0s the loaded wheelbarrow with grey broken stones heaped level with the tray rim, the bumpy gravel track and the brick stack at the left edge are already on screen and stay on screen; no other cart, tool, person, animal or material may appear, grow, float, fall or disappear at any moment, the stones in the tray must not change count or spill, and the tray must stay rigid and straight. BEATS: from 0.0s to 3.0s he walks forward pushing the loaded cart while speaking Indonesian with accurate lip sync, "Gerobak murah muat batu sedikit rodanya sudah goyang"; the tyre rolls over loose gravel, the cart does not wobble sideways. From 3.0s to 7.4s he keeps pushing over the broken paving, the tray does not flex, the frame stays aligned and both handles stay level while he says, "Five Star bak plat baja tebal, lewat jalan bergelombang rangkanya tetap kaku". From 7.4s to 10.4s he stops, lowers the cart onto its legs, presses the tray rim twice with a gloved hand, turns his head to the lens and says, "Simpan video ini buat acuan beli". From 10.4s to 12.0s he holds still with his hand on the rim and the loaded tray fully in frame. Ambient yard sound only: crunch of gravel under the tyre, soft metallic ring of the steel tray, distant construction clatter, no music. Natural clean daylight neutral white balance 5500K, true-to-life colours, realistic matte human skin with visible fine pores, no plastic shine, no waxy skin, no glass skin, no yellow or orange tint, no artificial golden glow, zero CGI, authentic non-AI documentary look. trend_sources.title: Wheelbarrow / Construction Cart (Kereta Sorong) - Hup Chongs Hardware
trend_sources.evidence: Halaman produk ini menyebut bak plat baja press tanpa sambungan agar tidak bocor dan tidak pecah saat menerima beban kejut, beban kerja 100 sampai 140 kg, serta ban angin yang lebih menyerap guncangan di medan lunak. Dipakai sebagai dasar klaim bahwa kekakuan bak dan ban angin menentukan ketahanan gerobak di jalan bergelombang, bukan sebagai klaim angka resmi Five Star.

trend_sources.title: Gerobak Sorong: Alat Sederhana yang Jadi Andalan di Setiap Proyek - Hasston
trend_sources.evidence: Artikel ini menulis gerobak sorong bak besi dengan material tebal punya kapasitas beban sampai 220 kg dan lebih tahan lama, serta mengingatkan tekanan angin ban harus dijaga supaya gerobak stabil dan material tidak tumpah saat dipindahkan.

trend_sources.title: Gerobak Dorong Logam Tugas Berat 150kg 100L Roda Pneumatik - Will Machinery
trend_sources.evidence: Spesifikasi produk ini mencantumkan kapasitas beban 150 kg dengan baki baja tugas berat dan roda pneumatik 4.00-8, dipakai sebagai pembanding umum bahwa gerobak proyek kelas ini memang dirancang memikul muatan batu dan kerikil, bukan untuk muatan ringan.
